basic_profile.bio: A passionate Star Wars fan who recently started delving into the vast universe of Reddit. Originally from the Midwest, this user is currently a college student majoring in computer science with a minor in history. They are fascinated by the lore and technology of fictional universes, especially those with intricate world-building like Star Wars. When not attending classes, they spend their free time playing Genshin Impact or browsing through various subreddits. They are in a relationship and often share inside jokes with their partner about Star Wars. Typical online hours are late evenings after classwork is done, usually between 9 PM and midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: A self-taught enthusiast of science fiction, especially Star Wars. Their knowledge stems from years of watching movies, reading books, and engaging with online communities dedicated to Star Wars lore. They have a keen interest in fictional technologies and how they compare to real-world advancements.
